plain: Nice work decoding this warmup! To solve, submit this exact answer to the Game Master: amber-lynx-42
generator_cmd: PYTHONPATH=tools/pyciphers python3 -c "import re,secretpy as S; ct=S.Trifid().encrypt(re.sub('[^a-z]','',plain.lower()), 9)"  # secretpy Trifid, default alphabet a-z + '.', key = period (0 = whole text).upper()
oracle_cmd: PYTHONPATH=tools/pyciphers python3 -c ...  # pycipher.delastelle.Delastelle('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.') chars='012' L2IND table to layer/row/col digits, per period block of L letters: digits d -> triplets (d[k], d[L+k], d[2L+k]) -> IND2L (its decipher() has a NameError bug, so the tables are used directly); period 9
